truth_contract: Security type is a factual historical attribute. Later primary evidence may establish an earlier historical fact. Future economic outcomes are prohibited.
classification_policy: Common corporate shares, ordinary shares, and ADR/ADS representing common shares are common. Preferreds, preferred-share ADSs, LP units, trust units, warrants, rights and other non-common instruments are non_common. Unclear hybrids remain unresolved.
